known_limitations: Clouds/shadows are not masked in this dataset.
LST is not available upstream; 6 channels used, not 7.

Pixels were randomly subsampled, and at a SMALLER sample size (2,000) than Technique 1's real-data run (8,000) due to SMACOF's much higher per-pixel cost (see this script's docstring) - metrics are not directly pixel-count-comparable to Technique 1's real-data results without accounting for this.
